title: How strongly does Abell 2744 lensing change candidate brightness rankings?
question: How do observed and approximately de-lensed F444W fluxes differ across the high-z sample?
results: Primary sample contains 1,179 candidates with F444W S/N >= 5 and mu <= 30
validation: Results are repeated across five magnification caps; a future DR4 v2.0 lens-map match is required for precision use.
provenance: UNCOVER DR3 SUPER catalog, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.11059273
limitations: F444W/mu is a flux proxy, not a luminosity function.
DR3 magnifications are superseded by the DR4 v2.0 lens model.
